title: lantana camara f. varia
intro: Lantana camara f. varia, commonly known as Buttonbush or Camara, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Verbenaceae family. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in reducing inflammation, lowering blood pressure, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lantana camara f. varia include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its various medicinal properties.
